articles.title: Anthropic Prices at $83 a Share in Record-Sized Offering
articles.content: Anthropic PBC and its co-founders raised $107.3 billion in an upsized IPO and private placement. The artificial intelligence firm sold 956.4 million shares and the co-founders sold 23.6 million shares for $83 each, according to a statement, above the marketed range. The IPO is the biggest of all time, topping SpaceX’s $75 billion base deal. Sopnendu Mohanty, Group CEO of Global Finance and Technology Network, discusses some of the risks associated with the valuation. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: 微软纳德拉示警：比“千年虫”更棘手，AI 正让网络变得越来越脆弱
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，美国当地时间 11 月 18 日在《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会上，微软首席执行官萨提亚 · 纳德拉（Satya Nadella）表示，近期频发的网络中断可能并非偶发事件，随着人工智能系统能力增强，全球数字基础设施的稳定性正面临更复杂的考验。针对近期接连出现的网络中断究竟是“反常现象”还是“新常态”，纳德拉表示目前尚难判断。他将当前形势与“千年虫”（Y2K）问题作类比：当年人们担心进入 2000 年后计算机系统会大面积瘫痪，但那本质上是一个已知漏洞，且只持续一天；而如今，若 AI 模型能力持续增强，其带来的系统性风险和连锁反应可能更难预测。IT之家援引博文介绍，纳德拉指出，过去工程师通常有数周时间测试和部署技术补丁，而现在他们却往往要在漏洞正被利用的同时进行检测、修复与防御。这意味着软件更新、系统运维和安全响应的节奏被大幅压缩，任何一处疏漏都可能被迅速放大。纳德拉特别强调，日常生活中的关键基础设施存在大量“无法修补”的漏洞。他举例称，固件、数据中心冷水机、暖通空调（HVAC）系统，甚至交通系统，都已连接互联网；一旦其中某个环节出现故障或遭到攻击，影响可能远超一次普通的服务中断。

articles.title: 微信鸿蒙版 App 获 8.0.23.46 邀测升级
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，微信鸿蒙版 App 在华为应用市场（App Gallery）发布了 8.0.23.46 (8394542) 版本邀测升级（需收到短信通知后点击链接跳转安装），测试时间为 2026/11/18-2026/12/18。和往常一样，本次更新的说明依旧为“修复了一些已知问题”。据博主 @伤心萨摩耶Ciuciu 以及 MeoW 反馈，8.0.23 版微信中发现的新特性包括但不限于（IT之家注：不局限于 8.0.23.46）：0.部分 Flutter 跨端页面（如朋友圈、听一听等页面）响应系统字体粗细；1.更换铃声选择界面右上角新增铃声设置入口，支持启用或停用个性化内容推荐；2.发表视频号内容时新增添加标注，视频号已发布的内容点击分享同步新增添加标注；3.发现 > 直播 > 更多直播新增搜索按钮；4.听一听主页面右下角新增小微分支入口悬浮按钮，并根据当前页面内容弹出对应提示词，可快速使用听一听相关问小微功能，播放页面点击分享新增问小微（主页面右下角悬浮按钮为逐步开放）；5.公众号图标焕新，对齐其他端；6.好友昵称、群昵称、备注、微信号、地区等信息支持长按复制；7.服务号信息流页面已关注的服务号发布的文章支持长按，选择不再关注或删除文章消息；8.聊天中的图片或视频点开右下角此聊天中的图片视频按钮样式更改（该条确认为 bug，已在 8.0.23.33 修复）；8.服务号信息流 > 推荐的贴图长按新增转发；9.聊天工具新增问小微（逐步开放，需账号灰度到小微主体）；10.直播页面支持显示当前直播转发分享人数；11.听一听浮标样式焕新；12.在具有管理权限的群聊中查看群成员资料，进群方式中邀请该群员进群的群员昵称变更为蓝色可点击状态；13.支持展示其他端设置的朋友圈点赞彩蛋；14.视频号内容点击分享新增问小微（逐步开放，需账号灰度到小微主体）；15.服务号的通知提醒红字部分新增新通知的服务号名称提醒，由 [n 条消息] 变更为 [xxx 等 n 条消息]；16.群收款右上角新增导入，支持在发起群收款时导入账单、群接龙、历史群收款（逐步开放，支持 8.0.22 及以上版本）；17.公众号 / 服务号主页 > 右上角… 新增更多信息，可查看公众号 / 服务号简介、关注时间、基础信息、名称记录、授权第三方服务等信息；18.小店与卡包 > 右上角…> 设置 > 隐私设置新增小程序订单授权开关，开启后小程序订单信息将同步至「小店与卡包 > 订单」（热更新）；19.开启群消息免打扰之后，群设置新增以下消息仍通知，可设置 @我、@所有人、群公告以及指定群成员的消息在群消息免打扰时仍通知（逐步开放）；20.设置＞消息通知＞新增消息提示音，可设置微信内置的 7 个提示音（逐步开放）；21.设置＞账号安全新增登录设备管理，可删除登录设备，删除后在对应设备登录需进行安全验证（逐步开放）；22.元宝＞体验更多支持跳转应用市场下载元宝 APP（热更新）；23.扫一扫融入小微分支，新增右上角翻转摄像头与底部拍照给 AI，支持识别、翻译、记住此刻、记住朋友（逐步开放，小微分支单独灰度）；24.服务号＞个人中心新增赞、收藏和最近阅读，记录赞、收藏和最近阅读过的贴图号内容（三端同步新增功能，仅展示贴图号发布的贴图，不展示公众号发布的贴图，8.0.23.33 或 34 版本新增）；25.部分视频号视频支持展示右下角小微分支悬浮提问快捷入口（热更新，仅部分视频支持显示，不展示小微分支悬浮提问的视频则展示原有悬浮搜索入口）；26.发表朋友圈时新增小微分支 AI 帮写（逐步开放）；27.听一听＞个人歌单新增歌单来源分类（微信音乐 / QQ 音乐 / 酷狗音乐），支持绑定 QQ 音乐 / 酷狗音乐账号并同步对应平台收藏歌曲（我喜欢）至听一听（逐步开放，前置条件需灰度到音乐空间，前置条件详见 8.0.16 第 19 条，可通过已有音乐空间的朋友创建空间并邀请加入激活）；28.发现＞直播界面逻辑重构对齐，取消更多直播入口，搜索按钮移至一级界面，新增双 11、看剧、颜值、资讯等更多个性化或限时分类（逐步开放，部分分类类型不固定，因账号而异）；29.我＞小店与卡包新增小店金币 tab，可签到领取金币（逐步开放）；30.听一听＞个人歌单＞右上角🎧沉浸听歌新增时光电台（逐步开放，需灰度到小微主体）；31.公众号文章标题下新增 AI 摘要，滑动阅读时右下角新增 AI 摘要悬浮按钮，长按选择文字新增问 AI（需更新至 8.0.23.35 及以上版本）；32.扫码登录鸿蒙电脑微信时支持选择自动登录该设备（逐步开放，鸿蒙电脑需更新至 4.1.13 及以上版本）；33.公众号文章或贴图点击分享新增问小微（需灰度到小微主体并更新至 8

articles.title: 供应链确认 OpenAI 首款 AI 硬件年底启动出货：前苹果设计师 Jony Ive 合作打造，立讯精密等中国厂商深度参与
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，每日经济新闻今日援引供应链消息，OpenAI 首款 AI 硬件产品计划于 2026 年底启动出货，多家中国厂商参与该项目，其中立讯精密独家承担整机制造，并同时供应核心零部件。关于这款硬件的具体形态，OpenAI 官方尚未正式公布。此前有报道称，该设备由 OpenAI 与前苹果首席设计官 Jony Ive 的 LoveFrom 工作室合作开发，可能是一款外形类似“甜甜圈”、尺寸接近冰球的无屏设备，集成麦克风、扬声器、摄像头及多种环境传感器，主要依靠语音交互并具备感知周围环境的能力。传闻中该产品定价可能在 300 至 400 美元（现汇率约合 2,004 至 2,672 元人民币）区间，但尚未得到官方确认。2026 年 1 月曾有报道称，OpenAI 首款 AI 硬件的代工订单可能从立讯精密转交鸿海，在越南工厂生产，立讯精密随后对相关传闻作出澄清。OpenAI 全球事务官 Chris Lehane 曾在 2026 年 1 月达沃斯论坛期间表示，公司“正按计划”于 2026 年下半年推出首款设备。

articles.title: 华为最薄 Mate 直板机来了，Mate90 Air 轻薄旗舰定档 11 月 24 日发布
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，华为今日官宣旗下最薄 Mate 直板机 —— 华为 Mate90 Air 轻薄旗舰，新机将于 11 月 24 日 14:30 举行的 HUAWEI Mate X8 及全场景新品发布会亮相。从外观上看，新机延续了华为 Mate 90 系列设计语言，采用圆环相机造型，预计机身整体将更加轻薄。作为参考，华为 Mate 90 标准版机型配备 6.75 英寸显示屏，机身重量约  217 克（含电池）。关于 Mate90 Air 轻薄旗舰的更多消息，IT之家也会持续关注并带来跟进报道。

articles.title: 美军把《GTA 6》变成留人福利：可 4 天畅玩游戏，43 名士兵已续签兵役合同
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，华盛顿邮报今天（11 月 19 日）发布博文，报道称美国陆军佐治亚州斯图尔特堡第 9 旅工兵营推出特殊留队激励：士兵若在规定期限内重新入伍、续签兵役合同，即可获得 4 天特别假期，让其畅玩《侠盗猎车手 6》（GTA6）游戏。最终，该营 130 名符合条件的士兵中，有 43 人选择签约，续期从 2 年到 6 年不等。这项政策由该营指挥官于 7 月底签署备忘录提出，适用于 8 月 1 日至 11 月 14 日期间重新入伍的士兵。军方强调，4 天假期并非续签的唯一原因，是在叠加现金奖励、岗位选择等常规留队激励之上的“额外福利”。这项“游戏假”定于 11 月 19 日至 22 日，恰逢《GTA 6》发售后的首个周末。战斗工程师中士贾米尔 · 史密斯（Jamire Smith）已选择续签 6 年，他表示本就计划重新入伍，并已获得 6 万美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 40.1 万元人民币）签约奖金，游戏假期只是“有趣的额外福利”。该创意由营内一名资深士官提出。她回忆称，2013 年《GTA 5》发售当周自己正参加基础训练，险些错过游戏；如今新作出炉，她希望用士兵真正感兴趣的方式，拉近基层官兵与指挥层之间的距离。营长虽未密切关注游戏发售动态，但熟悉 GTA 系列，最终批准了这项方案。《GTA 6》主线剧情据称约需 50 小时以上，四天假期对通关而言时间紧张，却足以让玩家体验游戏初期内容。

articles.title: Rockstar 解释《GTA 6》为何删减经典玩法：主线围绕 Jason 和 Lucia 情侣展开，仅保留符合人物情感与动机的设计
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，《侠盗猎车手 Ⅵ》（GTA 6）解禁后，有玩家发现 R 星取消了该系列延续多年的一项玩法：玩家无法再在街头招揽性工作者并付费购买相关服务。为此，Rockstar Games 向游戏媒体 Shacknews 解释称，这一调整主要是为了配合游戏的核心故事和人物关系，并非出于外界猜测的其他原因。Rockstar 表示：“《GTA 6》讲述的是一对陷入困境、亡命天涯的情侣的故事。虽然我们继承了此前《GTA》系列作品中的许多内容，但在《GTA 6》中加入的所有元素，都服务于我们希望讲述的故事，以及希望进一步扩展的游戏系统，例如通缉系统、广播电台、抢劫和汽车盗窃。”Rockstar 还表示，此前系列作品中的许多内容并未出现在《GTA 6》中，保留下来的元素则是为了配合玩家体验 Jason 和 Lucia 故事时希望强调的情感与人物动机。在此前的《GTA》作品中，玩家可以驾驶车辆在街头寻找性工作者，付费购买相关服务。这项经典玩法最早出现在 2001 年推出的《GTA 3》中，此后成为系列长期保留的特色之一（IT之家注：延续超 25 年）。此次《GTA 6》取消了这项设计，但并未完全移除游戏中的娱乐内容。玩家仍然可以前往脱衣舞俱乐部，甚至可以与伴侣 Jason 和 Lucia 一起前往相关场所。不过，玩家无法再像此前作品那样，通过街头互动招揽性工作者。与《GTA 5》相比，《GTA 6》更加重视两名主角之间的关系。前作采用 Michael、Franklin 和 Trevor 三名主角各自展开故事的设计，而新作则围绕 Jason 和 Lucia 这对情侣展开，人物关系也成为游戏叙事的重要组成部分。相关阅读：《超 250 万人同时围观，〈GTA 6〉发售仅半小时创下 Twitch 单机游戏收视纪录》《玩家为何能听见警察的无线电通话？〈GTA 6〉终于给出解释》《IGN 长文揭秘：R 星是如何打造出〈GTA 6〉的》《〈GTA 6〉M 站均分 99 分，追平〈塞尔达传说：时之笛〉并列史上第一》《13 年等待结束：〈侠盗猎车手 6〉今明日正式发售，登陆 PS5、Xbox Series X|S 平台》

articles.title: 三星 Galaxy Buds Active 耳挂式耳机曝光，支持 IP68 防水和主动降噪
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，据 SammyGuru 今日报道，该媒体在三星最新 One UI 9.5 测试版固件中发现了 Galaxy Buds Active 的大量信息，这款耳机采用耳挂式入耳设计，支持 IP68 防水与主动降噪。IT之家从报道获悉，Galaxy Buds Active 的耳挂会环绕耳廓上方，但它并不是开放式耳机。三星在教程中提示用户先将耳塞放入耳道，再向上旋转耳机，直到佩戴稳固。该耳机随附两种不同类型的耳塞，用户可以混搭组合，以改善音质并形成防水密封。防水方面，三星固件将该耳机标注为 IP68 等级，并描述其可在出汗或接触水时受到保护。三星提示，耳机沾水后应甩掉积水，用软布擦干后再放回充电盒。SammyGuru 指出，该等级仅针对耳机本体，未涉及充电盒，固件中也没有游泳相关的认证信息。操控方面，单击可播放或暂停，双击切换下一曲或接听、挂断电话，长按可唤起 AI 助手或拒接来电。长按操作也可以设置为音量调节，耳机还提供耳塞贴合度测试。音频方面，Galaxy Buds Active 支持主动降噪、环境音及环境音音量调节、降噪等级调节，并可在通话中使用环境音。声音菜单还包含均衡器、360 Audio、对话增强与响度标准化，支持最高 96kHz 的 UHQ 音频与超宽带语音，另有游戏模式。据报道，360 Audio 在该耳机上不包含头部追踪。连接方面，该耳机支持无缝连接、Auto Switch 与通话自动切换，并可在 Auracast 广播收听菜单中使用。报道同时提到，Galaxy Buds Active 没有提供自动入耳检测，取下耳机后不会自动暂停播放或切换通话，诊断菜单中也没有佩戴检测项目；同时，它不支持头部手势与单耳降噪控制。截至发稿，三星尚未公布 Galaxy Buds Active 的售价、续航、配色与发布时间，也不清楚该耳机是否会在中国内地市场推出。

articles.title: 微软 CEO 纳德拉谈 6 万人自愿离职计划：部分团队尚未适应 AI 转型，公司希望给予员工更多自主权、让合适的人才进入合适的岗位
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，当地时间 11 月 16 日，微软 CEO 萨提亚 · 纳德拉在接受《The Pragmatic Engineer》播客节目采访时谈到了一些大家关心的问题。当被问及公司面向约 6 万名员工推出自愿离职计划，是否意味着微软将借助 AI 提高效率并进一步裁员。对此，纳德拉没有直接给出肯定或否定的答复，而是坦言，随着 AI 改变软件开发方式，微软员工的工作模式和团队组织结构都将发生变化。纳德拉表示，微软希望旗下超过 20 万名员工都能继续成长，但公司需要以不同方式重新配置员工队伍。他指出，未来仍然存在大量职业发展机会，不过这些机会的具体形态可能有所不同，包括团队规模、工作流程以及岗位职责等方面。“我也希望自己能够坐在这里告诉大家，一切都会保持原样。但我做不到。”纳德拉承认，微软内部并非所有团队都已经适应 AI 带来的变化。他表示，不希望员工被困在一个没有完成转型的团队中，即使这个团队属于微软内部也是如此。如果员工感觉自己的职业发展受到限制，可以选择离开当前团队。不过，他更希望员工能够在微软内部寻找其他发展机会。这次采访由前微软工程师 Gergely Orosz 主持。面对有关自愿离职计划是否预示 AI 相关裁员的问题，纳德拉强调，公司希望给予员工更多自主权，让他们能够进入符合自身长期职业发展和经济利益的岗位。纳德拉还提到，系统工程师、基础设施人员以及 AI 训练研究人员等岗位的薪酬正在大幅上涨。微软希望通过相关安排，让员工有更多机会转向这些需求增长的领域。他同时表示，前向部署工程师（FDE）是微软目前增长最快的岗位之一。IT之家此前报道，微软于 2026 年 10 月 26 日正式公布自愿离职计划（Voluntary Exit Offer，简称 VEO）。微软首席人力资源官 Amy Coleman 表示，该计划面向美国、加拿大、英国和印度部分参与团队中职级为 70 级及以下的符合条件员工，提供经济补助和职业规划支持。具体参与范围由各业务部门根据业务优先级、客户承诺和人员需求决定。据《财富》杂志报道，微软方面确认约有 6 万名员工符合此次计划的申请条件，并预计实际肯接受其离职条件的人的比例低于 5%，即不足 3000 人。微软方面表示，推出计划并不意味着希望大量员工离开，而是希望让合适的人才进入合适的岗位。这项计划与微软此前推出的自愿退休计划有所不同。今年 4 月的自愿退休计划仅面向美国员工，并要求员工年龄与在微软服务年限之和达到 70 年；此次 VEO 则没有年龄和工龄门槛。Gergely Orosz 随后也在 X 上分享了自己对这次采访的理解。他预计，微软接下来可能进行规模较大的组织调整，逐步以原生 AI 团队作为新的组织模式。他还认为，自愿离职计划也可能促使一些认为自己所在团队缺乏转型进展的开发人员考虑外部机会。AI 已经在改变微软的软件开发流程。纳德拉此前透露，AI 生成的代码已经占微软代码总量的 20% 至 30%。微软杰出工程师 David Fowler 也曾表示，手动编写代码的传统工作方式正在发生变化。纳德拉认为，随着代码生成成本不断下降，软件开发的难点正在转向验证环节。他表示，在代码生成已经变得廉价的情况下，如何验证代码正确性，反而成为更加困难的问题。对于微软是否会恢复应届毕业生招聘，纳德拉承认公司目前放缓了相关招聘工作。他表示，微软首先需要重新调整现有员工的岗位配置，将员工安排到更适合的团队，然后再考虑增加校园招聘。纳德拉还谈到了 AI 对未来软件工程团队组织方式的影响。他认为，未来的 AI 原生企业可能从一名员工和一定数量的 AI Token 预算开始，随着工作量增加，再逐步引入更多人员。不过，他也强调，现在判断这种模式是否会成为长期趋势还为时过早。纳德拉最后承认，科技行业围绕技术奇点以及未来工作岗位可能消失等话题的讨论，已经给从业者带来了巨大的焦虑。对于微软此次获得自愿离职资格的约 6 万名员工而言，公司高层对 AI 转型和组织调整的表态，也意味着微软未来的岗位结构和团队工作方式可能继续发生变化。相关阅读：《微软 CEO 纳德拉畅想：未来可能有 2000 万个 AI 智能体与 20 万名员工协同工作》《微软大规模自愿离职补偿计划引员工担忧，高管澄清“并非要裁 6 万人”》《微软向约 6 万名员工推出自愿离职买断方案，适配 AI 时代人员结构调整》

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，吉利银河近日公布旗下首款旗舰大五座 SUV—— 银河 M8 更多车型信息，新车将提供五款全新车色，将于 2026 年第四季度正式上市。IT之家注意到，银河 M8 提供沧海银蓝、月瓷白、云绒米、玄夜黑以及鎏金棕五款车色。新车整体造型与吉利银河 M9 保持一致，车头配备带星光点缀的贯穿式灯带，下包围设有主动进气格栅。尺寸方面，该车长宽高为 5205mm*1999mm*1800mm，轴距 3030mm，采用大五座布局。车尾造型同样与银河 M9 基本保持一致。根据选装信息，该车可选金色车标，预计推出黑金智曜高定版；轮圈提供 20 英寸、21 英寸两种规格，共四种样式。座舱方面，银河 M8 内饰延续银河 M9 的设计，配备液晶仪表以及大尺寸悬浮中控屏，搭载全场景 AI Agent 智能体，配备“端到端 AI 语音大模型”。辅助驾驶方面，该车车顶搭载激光雷达。动力方面，新车搭载 1.5T 发动机与电机组成的插混系统，发动机最大功率 120kW。储能装置为宁德时代磷酸铁锂电池，电池容量 53.42kWh，纯电续航 231km/251km。

articles.title: OpenAI 自曝模型失控险情：最强 AI 曾突破网络封锁，紧急停训 11 天
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，OpenAI 今天（11 月 18 日）发布题为《管理前沿 AI 风险：从训练到部署》的安全政策说明，首次系统披露研发、内部使用到公开发布阶段，如何在高能力模型的全生命周期中管控风险。IT之家援引博文介绍，OpenAI 称由于前沿模型的能力正快速增强，因此理解、对齐和保障模型的能力必须“始终领先一步”。公司维持引入“安全案例”流程，要求在训练全程提供更有力的行为对齐证据；这些措施虽会拖慢发布节奏，但会增强安全推进的信心。OpenAI 强调其保护措施围绕四层展开：模型对齐：对齐就是让 AI 系统能够可靠地按照我们预期的方式行动。模型必须在尊重政策和更广泛的社会利益的前提下，解读用户的需求。安全和沙盒：这些控件限制模型能够访问或影响的文件、工具、网络及其他资源。它们有助于遏制培训和评估过程中错误或行为不一致所带来的后果。保障阻止措施：这些都是额外的防护措施，用于评估用户请求并建模阻止潜在有害或未经授权行为的行为。它们包括安全分类器，有助于防止网络滥用或协助生物武器，以及自动审核功能，可以阻止潜在的未经授权模型操作。监测与响应：这些系统能检测令人担忧的行为，调查发生了什么，并在必要时进行干预。它们为部署流量提供了可视化，并能提醒我们新兴的风险类型。文章特别提到今年 7 月的“Hugging Face 事件”。OpenAI 表示，该事件说明不能仅依靠沙盒隔离来约束高能力模型。此后，公司重构了内部研究系统，前沿模型训练环境将不接入实时互联网，并通过受限权限沙盒、虚拟机以及网络与云边界实现多层隔离。OpenAI 还披露另一件内部模型突破网络安全限制的事件。该事件发生于 9 月 20 日，一个正在接受训练的 AI 研究模型利用 DNS 配置漏洞，成功绕过网络隔离措施，获得有限的互联网访问权限。OpenAI 随后紧急叫停旗下能力最强模型的训练与评估，停训时间长达 11 天。为加快干预，OpenAI 建立了“控制室”（Control Room）系统：在收到停止指令后，可在 35 秒内停止研究工作负载的后续模型输出；该控制直接部署在推理基础设施中，不依赖各研究任务自行实现关停机制。在模型进入内部部署后，OpenAI 员工可让其访问更广泛的互联网、Slack、代码库及内部基础设施，风险也随之上升。公司表示，此时将更依赖模型对齐、系统级防护和实时监控，重点防范绕过安全限制、数据外泄及向未授权目的地发送敏感信息等行为。

articles.title: 谷歌推出 Gemini 4 Neon 模型，编程 AI 智能体指数超 Claude Opus 5.5 排第一
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，谷歌今天（11 月 18 日）宣布推出 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Neon，主攻复杂编程、科学研究和企业工作流程，更好平衡推理能力、任务处理速度与成本，目前已开始向开发者、企业及部分付费订阅用户开放。费用方面，Gemini 4 Neon 在 API 调用方面，每 100 万词元输入费用为 3 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 元人民币），每 100 万词元输出费用为 15 美元（现汇率约合 100.2 元人民币），缓存输入每百万 token 为 0.15 美元（现汇率约合 1 元人民币），并提供 Low、medium、high 以及 xhigh 四种推理级别。用户订阅 Google AI Pro 或 Ultra 后可以在 Gemini 应用中选择使用该模型。据谷歌介绍，Neon 支持 100 万 token 上下文窗口，可综合处理电子表格、PDF、图表、音频和视频，将分散信息整理成报告等成果。在编程场景中，它能够跨文件排查错误、重构代码，也可在谷歌 Antigravity 开发环境中协调多个 AI 子智能体执行复杂任务。性能方面，谷歌公布的数据显示，Neon 在最高 xhigh 档位下，以 61 分位列 Artificial Analysis 智能指数第三，并在该机构的编程智能体指数中以 58.6 分排名第一。默认 high 思考档位下，其在相关测试中的单任务成本比同系列 Carbon 模型低 32%。这些排名和成本比较均对应特定评测条件，不代表所有实际任务表现。谷歌称，在早期内部评估中，Neon 的整体任务质量达到或超过更大型的 Gemini 4 Carbon，任务完成速度达到后者的 3 倍。Neon 的重点在于持续处理多步骤工作，例如排查大型代码库中的错误、分析大量数据，以及协调多个 AI 智能体分工协作。在谷歌 Antigravity 环境中，它可充当“调度员”，让 Hydrogen 子智能体并行处理不同任务，并在长时间运行时同步进展。

articles.title: 马斯克、奥尔特曼、纳德拉等人出席 DealBook 峰会，回应热点问题
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，当地时间 11 月 18 日，2026 年度 DealBook 峰会在美国纽约举行。《纽约时报》财经专栏作家、DealBook 创始人安德鲁・罗斯・索尔金主持了此次活动。OpenAI CEO 萨姆・奥尔特曼、总裁格雷格・布罗克曼、SpaceX CEO 埃隆・马斯克、微软 CEO 萨提亚・纳德拉等科技行业人士出席，围绕 AI 发展、行业竞争、企业上市及技术安全等话题展开讨论。马斯克目前人在深圳，他通过视频连线出席此次峰会。据其透露，SpaceX 计划于 2027 年开始发射新一代 Starlink Direct-to-Cell（手机直连卫星）V2 卫星，进一步提升卫星通信能力。据介绍，新一代卫星将大幅提升网络带宽，用户无需购买专用硬件，即可通过现有智能手机连接卫星网络。根据 SpaceX 此前公布的技术资料，V2 手机直连卫星将采用定制芯片和相控阵天线，并结合新增频谱资源及优化后的 5G 协议。SpaceX 官方曾披露，单颗新一代卫星的吞吐能力预计达到第一代的约 20 倍，整个系统的总容量提升幅度则超过 100 倍。除卫星网络外，SpaceX 还计划建设地面移动通信基础设施，以改善卫星信号难以覆盖的室内区域。马斯克提出利用公司获得的 800 MHz 频段部署大量小型地面基站，考虑将相关设备与 Starlink 卫星互联网终端结合，安装在住宅和商业建筑的屋顶上。与传统大型移动通信基站相比，这种方案希望利用现有 Starlink 终端的部署基础，通过增加小型地面通信设备提供手机网络覆盖（800 MHz 相比更高频率的无线信号在建筑物内的传播能力更有优势）。SpaceX 总裁兼首席运营官格温・肖特韦尔此前也介绍过类似方案，称公司希望通过部署小型基站补充卫星直连网络，而不是完全依赖传统大型蜂窝基站。马斯克预计，相关设备设计将在明年进入生产阶段。对于传统电信运营商的竞争问题，马斯克表示，他并不认为 AT&T 和 Verizon 会因此退出市场，顶多只是损失一些收入罢了。不过，他认为未来通信带宽需求的主要增长动力将不再只是普通消费者，而是超级智能（Superintelligence）和机器人等应用。马斯克此前曾预测，未来 3 至 5 年通信带宽需求可能增长约 1000 倍，原因是 AI 智能体和机器人数量不断增加，且单个智能体的数据通信需求可能远高于普通人类用户。当谈及 SpaceX 与特斯拉的潜在合并，以及特斯拉未来的自动驾驶车型规划。他表示，将 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并，可能有助于两家公司共同发展先进人工智能和机器人技术。“它们不一定需要合并，但合并后会不会更好？可能会。”马斯克说。不过，他强调，任何此类交易最终都需要由 SpaceX 和特斯拉的股东决定。马斯克还表示，特斯拉计划推出一款能够完全在无人类驾驶员干预的情况下运行的 Model Y 新版本。该车型将取消方向盘和踏板，主要用于多人出行，可搭载 6 至 7 人。马斯克称，双座车型能够满足 90% 的汽车出行需求，但特斯拉也有必要推出能够搭载不同人数乘客的车型。他表示，公司将考虑生产适应不同载客需求的汽车。在谈到其政治立场时，马斯克强调自己“不是 MAGA”。他对自己之前在中期选举中斥巨资帮助共和党的行为感到后悔，现在觉得当时的做法“相当愚蠢”。“这无疑表明，美国选举不仅仅是钱的问题”，马斯克说，“如果可以重来，我会少花点钱。”在谈及英伟达前 CEO 黄仁勋时，马斯克为其公开辩护。马斯克对黄仁勋离职表示震惊。他将这一决定比作一支球队在连胜期间突然让迈克尔・乔丹坐上替补席，认为这对股东而言并不合理。“虽然黄仁勋犯了错误，但我并不认为他对美国不忠”。马斯克还表示，如果有机会，他愿意聘用黄仁勋，并称任何人都会愿意这样做。谈到俄乌冲突时，马斯克表示，乌克兰一直在使用 SpaceX 提供的民用 Starlink 卫星通信服务支持对俄作战。马斯克还直接批评泽连斯基，称其“并非总是诚实”。除马斯克外，奥尔特曼也谈到了 AI 行业的竞争与安全问题。他认为，AI 企业之间过于激烈的竞争可能带来风险，并表示：“在迷雾中进行竞赛是一件坏事。”他认为，当前行业更需要谨慎，而不是进一步加速竞争。针对加州总检察长罗布・邦塔此前对 OpenAI 提起的诉讼，奥尔特曼表示，公司不同意相关指控。他承认，公司也希望此前发生的 Hugging Face 安全事件没有发生，但同时强调，AI 技术仍处于发展初期，只有面对真实世界中的问题，才能逐步找到保障技术安全的方法。奥尔特曼和布罗克曼还谈到了黄仁勋离职一事。两人表示，已经通过私人渠道联系黄仁勋，向他及其家人表达关心。奥尔特曼称，黄仁勋是最早大力支持 OpenAI 的重要人士之一，并表示很难想象没有黄仁勋的 AI 行业。微软 C

articles.title: 2GB 内存的手机也能流畅用 AI，谷歌降低安卓 Gemini App 使用门槛
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，谷歌昨日（11 月 18 日）发布博文，宣布面向 Android Go 设备开放 Gemini 应用，让内存较小的安卓手机（英文原文中并未提及具体内存容量）也能使用其个人 AI 助手。谷歌表示通过重新设计应用架构，可以在内存较小的手机上流畅运行 Gemini 的核心体验，从而扩大其个人 AI 助手的用户群体，潜在覆盖人群达数亿人。此次适配不仅提供基础文字问答，还涵盖语音交流、相机辅助理解和图像创作。用户可以通过 Gemini Live，以超过 45 种语言讨论问题、练习面试；也可以将相机对准笔记或表格，获取学习与翻译帮助，或使用 Nano Banana 生成图片，例如为周末的烘焙义卖制作宣传单。在同日发布的墨西哥相关公告中，谷歌进一步表示，经过重新设计的 Gemini 应用可在运行内存低至 2GB 的手机上流畅运行，为学生和小商户提供学习辅导、语音交互及创作支持。IT之家附上相关视频如下：获取方式方面，用户可通过 Google Play 下载应用；部分受支持手机也可通过长按电源键启动。谷歌还表示，传音等合作伙伴未来推出的设备将预装 Gemini。

articles.title: 地平线发布 LoFT 原生视频几何基础模型，多项指标达到 SoTA
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，11 月 18 日，地平线机器人实验室发布原生视频几何基础模型 LoFT（Looped Foundation Transformer for Video Geometry）。据介绍，该模型能够从 RGB 视频中联合预测相机位姿、内参及逐帧深度，恢复场景三维结构，为机器人空间感知、环境理解与具身学习提供几何基础。官方称，LoFT 原生面向连续视频建模，采用双循环 Transformer 架构，将跨帧视觉信息聚合与相机状态迭代优化相结合，用于挖掘视频中的时序关联与多视角几何信息。IT之家从官方公布信息获悉，第一循环通过局部与全局时序注意力聚合跨帧信息，逐步扩大时间感受范围，利用相邻帧的连续性与跨视角的几何关联；第二循环显式更新相机位姿与内参，并将相机状态反馈至下一轮特征计算。模型结合双循环特征预测逐帧深度及其置信度，恢复场景的可见三维结构。▲ 原生双循环 Transformer：LB1 通用几何特征提取，LB2 实现 Coarse2Fine 几何与姿态估计官方表示，为支撑规模化训练，团队搭建了统一的三维重建数据处理与训练平台，约 297 万条有效训练序列、9.62 亿帧图像记录，覆盖仿真与真实、动态与静态等多样化场景，并通过统一的数据清洗、质量筛选和采样策略提供数据基础。▲ 高频动态场景下的精准空间感知▲ 实现文字级精细几何重建▲ 驾驶场景中对动态车辆的鲁棒视觉重建▲ 复杂生活场景高精度重建评测方面，研究团队在 SpatialBench、ClassicBench 和 VRBench 三套评测体系中将 LoFT 与 VGGT-Ω、DA3-Giant 等代表性模型比较。其中 SpatialBench 覆盖 12 个数据集、98 个连续视频场景；ClassicBench 整合 7 个经典视频重建基准；VRBench 涵盖机器人、自动驾驶及通用视频场景。据官方公布信息，LoFT 在多项深度估计指标上达到 SoTA。▲ 通用 3D 空间重建评测 SpatialBench，多项指标达到 SoTA▲ 在经典重建 ClassicBench 和连续视频重建 VRBench 中达到 SoTA 效果在应用侧，官方称 LoFT 可利用连续视频中的时序与多视角几何信息，恢复场景三维结构与相机运动轨迹，覆盖机器人第一人称视频、动态街道、室内操作及开放环境探索等场景。参考项目主页

articles.title: Nginx 被曝出 NGINX2Root 漏洞链：攻击者无需认证即可远程执行命令，结合 Linux 内核漏洞可获取宿主机 root 权限
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，安全研究团队 Xint Security Research 于当地时间 11 月 18 日公开披露了一串名为 NGINX2Root 的漏洞攻击链，涉及 5 个 Nginx 远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，以及 1 个 Linux 内核 SCTP 子系统权限提升漏洞。攻击者无需身份认证，即可利用特定配置下的 Nginx 漏洞执行任意命令；如果进一步结合 Linux 内核漏洞，还可能实现 Docker 容器逃逸并获取宿主机 root 权限。据 Xint 技术报告，5 个 Nginx 漏洞分别对应不同的功能和配置场景，涉及 HTTP/2、HTTP/3、反向代理及邮件代理等模块，并非所有漏洞都需要同时利用。IT之家注意到，其中影响范围较广的是 CVE-2026-123007，该漏洞源于 HTTP/2 流量控制中的整数溢出问题，可导致堆内存越界写入。只要 Nginx 监听端口启用了 HTTP/2，就可能受到影响。另外 4 个漏洞分别为 CVE-2026-123634、CVE-2026-123633、CVE-2026-121810 和 CVE-2026-113425，涉及特定反向代理配置、HTTP/2 上游连接、HTTP/3 上游请求以及邮件代理功能。攻击者成功利用后，可以在处理请求的 Nginx Worker 进程权限下执行命令。Xint 研究人员还演示了完整攻击链：首先利用 Nginx 远程代码执行漏洞，在 Docker 容器内部以 Nginx Worker 权限执行命令，随后利用 Linux 内核 SCTP 子系统中的另一处漏洞提升权限，最终突破容器隔离，取得底层宿主机的 root 权限。研究团队表示，相关测试还覆盖了 AWS、谷歌云和微软 Azure 等云环境。根据欧洲网络安全机构 CERT-EU 同日发布的安全公告，F5 已公开处理这 5 个 Nginx 漏洞，但截至公告发布时，尚未发现这些漏洞已在野外遭到实际利用的报告。CERT-EU 建议优先检查面向互联网开放的 Nginx 服务。在修复方面，Xint 建议升级至 Nginx 1.31.9。Sophos 发布的安全公告则确认，Nginx Open Source 1.30.7 和 1.31.9 已包含相关漏洞修复，Nginx Plus 也已发布对应修复版本。暂时无法升级的管理员，可以通过关闭 HTTP/2 缓解其中 CVE-2026-123007 和 CVE-2026-123633 两个漏洞的风险，但这一措施无法覆盖其余漏洞。

articles.title: 我国成功发射实践二十四号卫星，长征系列运载火箭第 678 次飞行
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，据央视新闻报道，北京时间 2026 年 11 月 19 日 6 时 51 分，我国在太原卫星发射中心使用长征二号丁运载火箭，成功将实践二十四号卫星发射升空，卫星顺利进入预定轨道，发射任务取得圆满成功。此次任务是长征系列运载火箭的第 678 次飞行。延伸阅读实践二十四号卫星属于我国的实践系列卫星。该系列卫星主要用于科学探测与技术实验，是我国卫星家族中诞生最早、成员最为庞大的系列之一。1971 年 3 月 3 日，我国发射了第一颗科学实验卫星实践一号，它是中国发射的第二颗卫星，基于东方红一号备份星研制，设计寿命为一年，但实际在太空中工作了 8 年之久。执行本次任务的长征二号丁运载火箭由中国航天科技集团有限公司八院抓总研制，是常温液体二级运载火箭，具备不同轨道要求下单星、多星发射能力，其 700 公里太阳同步轨道运载能力为 1.3 吨。本次任务是长征系列运载火箭的第 678 次飞行。此前的第 677 次飞行于 2026 年 11 月 11 日在酒泉卫星发射中心实施，由长征二号丁运载火箭将探源计划探路者卫星送入太空。

articles.title: 谷歌推出 Stitch Loop：定位永远不下班的“产品进化器”，替你盯着产品改 Bug
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，谷歌旗下 Google Labs 昨日（11 月 18 日）推出实验性产品智能体 Stitch Loop，可连接代码库与线上实时数据，在软件发布后持续发现问题、提出改进方案并编写代码。与完成单次任务便结束的工具不同，该智能体围绕团队设定的目标全天候运行，目标达成后仍会监测，防止相关指标再次下滑。IT之家附上相关演示视频如下：Stitch Loop 支持 180 多种集成，也可通过自定义 MCP 服务器或本地命令行上传资料。其工作流程包括发现改进机会、提供备选方案、编写代码和跟踪效果，形成持续优化循环。在默认情况下，Stitch Loop 会执行网络安全、响应延迟和无障碍访问 3 次循环（用户可以额外设置循环次数），每次循环都会经历以下 4 个步骤：建议：Stitch Loop 以产品中的证据为基础，呈现出实现目标进展的机会。解决方案：每个建议都附带一个或多个解决方案，个隔离的云沙盒中编写代码，并打开一个 GitHub 拉取请求以供你审阅。在相关情况下，PR 将包含 Loop 所完成工作的截图和视频。反思：Stitch Loop 会实时监控产品数据，帮助你实现目标，从每一个正面或负面结果中学习，以提升下一轮洞察。一旦目标达成，它就会持续观察，以防改动失误。在执行环节，智能体会根据用户选定的方案，在隔离的云端沙箱中编写代码，再向 GitHub 提交代码合并申请，必要时附上截图或视频。谷歌强调，所有改动都必须经过人工审核才能合并，最终决定权仍在人类手中。

articles.title: Omdia：2026 年 Q3 中东智能手机出货量同比下降 29%，创两年来最大跌幅，入门机型加速萎缩
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，11 月 18 日，根据 Omdia 最新研究，2026 年第三季度，中东地区（不包括土耳其）智能手机出货量同比下降 29%，至 1,070 万部，创两年来最大跌幅。IT之家从报告获悉，零部件成本上涨、入门级设备供应有限以及零售需求疲软是导致市场下滑的主要因素。此外，夏季旅游带来的季节性需求放缓、地缘政治不确定性以及渠道补货趋于谨慎，也进一步加剧了市场压力。随着手机价格持续上涨，各厂商更加注重库存管理，并有选择性地提供市场支持，尤其是在低价智能手机细分市场。报告提到，中东地区各市场的下滑幅度并不一致。沙特阿拉伯智能手机出货量同比下降 29%，阿联酋下降 12%。尽管市场推出了返校季促销和国庆日优惠活动，但零售商表示，在夏季旅游旺季延长的情况下，门店客流量仍有所减少。伊拉克市场表现尤为疲软，智能手机出货量同比大幅下降 58%，降至 2023 年第一季度以来的最低季度水平。货币汇率承压、政治和经济环境不稳定，以及智能手机价格持续上涨，进一步削弱了这一价格敏感型市场的消费者购买力。在中东其他市场，宏观经济方面的挑战也进一步加大了手机厂商的运营压力。“中东智能手机市场的价格水平正在不断上升，但这并不一定意味着消费者的偏好正转向高端机型。”Omdia 首席分析师 Manish Pravinkumar 表示，“随着零部件成本上涨不断压缩入门级机型的利润空间，厂商正逐步缩减低价机型的产品布局，并将重点转向利润率更高的产品。这一趋势导致售价低于 200 美元的智能手机出货量大幅下降 56%，而 400 至 599 美元价格区间的出货量则增长 65%，推动该地区智能手机平均售价（ASP）升至创纪录的 511 美元。三星（Samsung）：受 Galaxy A17 和 A07 4G 需求强劲以及零部件供应稳定的推动，三星市场份额从去年同期的 34% 提升至 45%。其覆盖多个价格区间的广泛产品组合，有助于在消费者价格敏感度不断提高的情况下，减轻出货量下滑带来的影响。小米：凭借 Redmi 17 4G 和 Redmi A7 Pro 4G，小米重返市场第二位。与此同时，公司继续调整入门级产品布局，将更多资源集中于利润率较高的机型和市场。苹果（Apple）：尽管出货量有所下降，苹果的市场份额仍提升至 12%，这主要得益于高端市场需求以及成熟的渠道合作关系。由于 iPhone 18 标准版在发布时缺席，与去年同期覆盖更广的 iPhone 17 产品阵容相比，苹果向渠道的出货量有所减少。荣耀（HONOR）：在连续三年实现增长后，荣耀首次出现两位数的出货量下滑，尽管其通过 HONOR Choice T10 进一步拓展了 150 美元以下价格区间的产品布局。HONOR X7e 约占荣耀总出货量的五分之一，凸显了其较高价位 X 系列机型仍然发挥着重要作用。传音（TRANSSION）：受零部件成本上涨冲击低价市场策略的影响，传音在前五大厂商中出货量降幅最大。其中，TECNO 凭借 Spark Go 3 等机型成为传音旗下出货量最大的品牌。尽管市场需求疲软，伊拉克和沙特阿拉伯仍是传音集团的重要市场。参考Omdia：2026 年 Q3 中东智能手机出货量同比下降 29%，创两年来最大跌幅

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，OpenAI 于当地时间 11 月 18 日发布最新技术报告《Advancing chip design with OpenAI models》，披露了利用 AI 模型辅助芯片设计的最新进展。据介绍，OpenAI 已将相关技术应用于自研推理芯片 Jalapeño，以及 AMD 下一代 GPU 和 CPU 的设计优化，并通过开源 RISC-V 处理器测试评估不同代际模型的芯片设计能力。OpenAI 表示，早在 2025 年初，工程师就开始使用 GPT-4o 辅助设计 Jalapeño。即使是当时的模型，也已经能够在芯片性能、功耗和面积（PPA）方面提出实质性改进方案。在 Jalapeño 的向量计算单元中，AI 模型通过优化浮点加法器、乘法器、转换函数、归约逻辑和特殊功能单元，减少硬件资源占用。在矩阵计算单元中，AI 模型成功改进了浮点运算和低精度点积电路。其中，一项乘法器重新设计方案使综合后的标准单元面积减少约 15%，同时将运算延迟从两个时钟周期缩短至一个时钟周期；另一项加法器设计也将标准单元面积减少约 15%，同时保持两个时钟周期的延迟。OpenAI 估算，模型提出的修改使 Jalapeño 向量计算单元的标准单元面积减少约 13%，矩阵计算单元减少约 10%。这些优化已经通过实际芯片验证。在与 AMD 的合作中，OpenAI 模型也参与了 GPU 和 CPU 芯片设计优化。OpenAI 称，在 AMD 旗舰 GPU IP 上，相较于经过高度优化的基准设计，模型带来了最高 14% 的 PPA 改进。相关模型通过重写描述芯片电路的 SystemVerilog RTL 代码，进一步优化了电路结构。OpenAI 表示，这相当于将约一年的设计优化进展压缩到不到 5 个月内完成。AMD 已经将部分优化成果纳入近期送交制造的芯片设计，其他修改则被加入生产设计文件，供后续产品使用。此外，AMD 还在其下一代旗舰 CPU 的关键模块中验证了模型带来的个位数百分比 PPA 提升。为评估不同代际 AI 模型独立完成芯片设计任务的能力，OpenAI 还选择了两款开源 32 位 RISC-V 处理器内核进行测试，分别是面向 FPGA 的 PicoRV32，以及作为 OpenTitan 安全芯片嵌入式处理器的 Ibex。测试中，OpenAI 向模型提供原始硬件描述代码，要求其提高处理器吞吐量，并通过仿真检查设计正确性。对于通过检查的设计，研究人员还会结合隐藏测试负载下的每时钟周期指令数和 Yosys 估算的最高时钟频率，计算每秒执行指令数。若设计未通过正确性检查，或者芯片面积超过原始设计的 16 倍，则记为零分。测试结果显示，在每次运行预算约为 11.2 万 Token 的条件下，GPT-6.2 Astra 在 PicoRV32 和 Ibex 两款处理器上的平均得分均最高。以现有 PicoRV32 内核为基础进行优化时，GPT-6.2 Astra 在相近预算下的得分约为 GPT-6 Astra 的两倍。OpenAI 还进行了另一项测试：不再要求模型优化现有处理器，而是直接提供书面规格和代码模板，让模型从零设计 RISC-V 处理器内核，自行决定数据流动方式和流水线阶段划分。在这一任务中，所有五款参与测试的模型，在约 11.2 万 Token 的运行预算下，得分均高于优化现有设计时的表现。IT之家注意到，整个评估覆盖两种设计任务、两款处理器内核及不同 Token 预算，共包含 9881 次计分运行。不过，OpenAI 也指出，从规格重新设计处理器时，模型可能省略原有芯片中的性能计数器和额外指令等功能，而这些功能对测试中的吞吐量目标帮助有限，因此可能部分解释得分提升。若要求模型保留这些功能、进一步限制电路面积，并在物理综合后检查时序，测试结果会更接近实际量产芯片设计场景。在后续计划方面，OpenAI 宣布与电子设计自动化（EDA）软件厂商新思科技（Synopsys）合作，训练名为 GPT-Synopsys 的新模型，使其能够像专业芯片设计人员一样使用新思科技的 EDA 工具，完成芯片设计与验证工作。OpenAI 表示，此次研究证明，AI 模型不仅能够探索新的处理器架构，也已经能够在 Jalapeño 以及 AMD 下一代旗舰 GPU、CPU 等复杂量产设计基础上提出进一步优化方案。

articles.title: NEBench R1: a Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Nuclear Domain Competence in Large Language Models
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21682v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21832v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to automate AI R&D, misaligned systems could sabotage research intended to improve model safety and alignment. To stress-test defenses against such sabotage, we use a human expert as a proxy saboteur on AI safety research. We conduct a red-team/blue-team game where a human researcher runs AI safety experiments from scratch and auditors try to tell which were sabotaged and how. Given access to the full research transcript and the ability to run experiments, human auditors mostly fail to distinguish sabotaged from benign research: they achieve an AUROC of 0.59, not significantly better than chance, and fully identify the specific sabotage in only 17% of cases. Abstract: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. Abstract: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously. Recent parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark) improve draft quality by conditioning on rich features computed by the target, through a mechanism known as feature encoding. Abstract: A reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. Deciding whether to stop means comparing two probabilities at the same point of a chain: that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct (its commitment), and that the answer it will finish with is correct (its verdict). We show that the verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot make this comparison. As a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift, whether continuing helps or hurts. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. We measure both on MATH-500. Abstract: The regulation of Artificial Intelligence is susceptible to various forms of capture by industry actors that hold undue influence over the policymaking process, due in part to their information advantage in developing these technologies. Abstract: AI agents can assist scientific research, but balancing autonomous investigation with scientists' ability to inspect and redirect ongoing work remains a central design challenge. Scientists select, refine, or replace hypotheses between research rounds, while audit agents interrogate checkpointed records to trace claims, reproduce analyses, and inform subsequent decisions. Across two predictive modeling tasks, DiscoveryAgent produced the best variable-star classifier among evaluated baselines and, with scientist steering, a protein variant-effect predictor surpassed by only one of 106 ProteinGym baselines. Abstract: Large language models are moving from isolated assistants toward autonomous agents that can plan, use tools, and coordinate with others, motivating an emerging Agentic Web of independently developed agents and services. Abstract: Personal assistants accumulate months of conversations, but today's long-term memory stacks put derivation or selection between a question and its evidence. In a system-level comparison on LongMemEval, two commercial assistants scored well below the same model reading the history offline [1], consistent with, but not isolating, content loss between write and read. We propose KV-LTM: a memory tier storing each session's raw text plus its KV cache under a fixed reader model, answering by restoring cached sessions and appending the question. KV-LTM is complementary to, not a replacement for, retrieval and indexing. Text is the memory of record; the cache is a recompute-free prefill accelerator, degrading gracefully to text. articles.content:

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations are often seen as counterfactual conditionals under closest-world semantics, requiring one to reason over all minimally distant counterexamples. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21688v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tool-using agents rely on execution harnesses to organize and schedule tool operations. The same task and resource description can conceal runtime conditions that reverse the latency ordering of valid execution plans. Resolving this uncertainty requires firsthand execution in the target setting. We introduce DeltaHarness, an execution-guided policy-search method that adapts agent harnesses from cold-start measurements. Its QHI loop uses the observed response to update runtime dispatch, revise physical plans, and select experiments for later proposals. An independent confirmation panel controls policy replacement. With fixed dispatch, a revised materialization policy reduces complete-delivery latency by 30.0% on one video-editing task across three fresh pairs. On held-out tasks, the evolved policies reduce latency by 8.2% relative to the best fixed plan in one seed and by 4.6% relative to the initial proposal in another.

articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21766v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Practitioners choose among LLM alignment methods largely by trial and error. We provide a theoretical foundation: each pairwise method defines a vector field on the probability simplex that governs how the model redistributes mass between preferred and dispreferred completions. Projecting onto a single preferred/dispreferred pair reduces this to a one-dimensional margin ODE with a closed-form solution. These solutions reveal that DPO margins grow without bound (logarithmically as $O(\log t)$ in the gradient-flow limit) while IPO margins converge to a finite $1/(2\tau)$; that label noise induces a qualitative phase transition in DPO (unbounded $\to$ bounded) but affects IPO only quantitatively; and that gradient concentration under asymmetric weighting governs trainability at scale. Abstract: The ocean absorbs almost 30% of anthropogenic CO$_2$ emissions, but quantifying this sink requires estimating surface-ocean CO$_2$ from observations that are sparse in space and time. Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. Abstract: Open crime data support urban safety analysis but reflect reported incidents rather than the complete distribution of criminal activity, potentially introducing spatial distortions in downstream analysis. Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. Abstract: Curvature-enhanced graph convolutional networks (CGCN) incorporate Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), grounded in optimal transport theory, into message passing, motivated by the claim that curvature-weighted edges alleviate "over-squashing" at structural bottlenecks. Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Abstract: We study constrained contextual bandits, in which a learner chooses one of $K$ actions in each round to minimize loss while keeping the expected cost of its play below a budget. Abstract: We present WM-Quant, to our knowledge, the first post-training quantization (PTQ) framework designed specifically for JEPA-style world models. Abstract: Deployed LLMs field hundreds of millions of conversations a day and refuse a non-trivial fraction of user requests, yet the user-side cost of refusal, whether users disengage and by how much, is unmeasured on any production model: a blind spot for the consumer-facing platforms built on them. arXiv:2611.21653v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis is critical for automated trading, portfolio management, and risk assessment, heavily relying on models like FinBERT. arXiv:2611.21669v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Masked diffusion models repeatedly predict provisional tokens before a sampler decides which predictions become permanent. For the first, we introduce counterfactual target-aware commitment, which ranks unresolved positions by a mixture of model confidence and leave-one-token-out target contribution. Abstract: AI systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making contexts, where interactions among components can introduce fairness risks that remain undetected when auditing components or collective outcomes in isolation. Abstract: Realistic user simulation enables the study of human interactions when direct experimentation is costly or potentially harmful. We introduce SimAI, a framework for mechanistic user simulation that models how psychological factors interact to shape user responses. To overcome the challenge of supervising open-ended behavior, we propose a graph reconstruction objective that provides graph-level rewards based on how well simulated conversations reflect the underlying psychological relationships. Abstract: Evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in Persian law remains challenging because benchmarks lack realism, grounding, and coverage of legal reasoning. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21878v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Language models are increasingly asked where real actors stand: what a party's platform prioritises, what an institution has committed to. Such judgments are gradable, carrying both an order and a magnitude. Nearly every benchmark that tests them asks about one entity at a time, then reads that score as the model's knowledge of the domain. Order and magnitude, however, need not be acquired together. Text about social entities carries far more comparison than measurement, so a model may hold a dependable ordering with no anchored scale beneath it. We ask whether a model can place a documented social position on a scale or only order the actors it compares, and what that means for how such knowledge is measured. Abstract: Automatic assignment of ICD-10 codes from short clinical diagnosis text is a practical medical text classification and normalization task. The task is difficult because diagnosis phrases are short and noisy, the ICD-10 label space is hierarchical, and the class distribution is strongly imbalanced. The evaluation uses a leakage-safe validation protocol: model and threshold selection are based on out-of-fold cross-validation predictions, while final reporting is performed on a locked test set with no shared source-file groups. The supervised conditional parent-code candidate generator reaches 74.32% Top-1 accuracy on the locked test set and 93.05% Top-10 candidate coverage. Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on medical question answering and diagnostic reasoning benchmarks. However, existing evaluations typically provide all patient information upfront and assess only the final diagnosis or rationale. Each benchmark instance is built from a PubMed Central case report and includes an initial presentation, an event bank, a clinical course, and diagnostic references. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21782v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Interactive video world models serve as simulators for embodied agents: from a starting image and an action trajectory, they generate the views the agent would see. The starting image fixes how high the camera is, for example 0.15 m for a floor robot or 2.2 m for an overhead camera, and a faithful simulator must keep this height as the camera moves. We show that six recent open-weight models fail to do so: as motion replaces the starting view with generated content, they move the camera toward human eye level, a failure we call camera-height regression. Our benchmark, EyeHeight, pairs six rendered elevations (0.15 m to 2.2 m) and four calibrated real-world rig heights with scale-free multi-view height estimation. articles.title: AR-WAM: efficient streaming world-action modeling for autonomous driving
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21851v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autonomous driving requires anticipating how traffic will evolve while responding quickly to new observations. Video foundation models offer the first ability, but repeated history encoding and iterative video generation make them costly to use for driving. We present AR-WAM, an efficient streaming world-action model that combines autoregressive temporal modeling with single-pass future conditioning. Because its video backbone is causal, AR-WAM updates its visual context incrementally, reusing past computation and conditioning future prediction on observed motion. Abstract: Published face-privacy methods report protection above 90% against black-box recognition models. That number comes from an evaluation protocol with two independent defects, reported in a measure that cannot size either one. Abstract: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV)-conditioned large language models (LLMs) enable language-interactive driving, but onboard deployment requires efficient perception and continuous planning alongside autoregressive language generation. Abstract: Making automated vehicles accessible requires consideration of vulnerable road users, including wheelchair users. To offer a more tailored experience that supports independence for this group, vehicle design needs to accommodate the wide range of wheelchair configurations. However, wheelchairs are individualized, varying in frame geometry, propulsion, and visual appearance. Moreover, occupants or accessories may obscure visual cues. Existing mobility-aid datasets only label the presence of a wheelchair, rather than describing its specific configuration. To fill this gap, this paper introduces the Wheelchair Configuration Image Dataset (WCID), comprising 467 face-blurred images across 192 capture groups solely for evaluation. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.21955v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Worldwide neuroimaging data could strengthen diagnostic foundation models, but privacy rules often prevent centralizing brain MRI scans. We present SCAN, a site-aware collaborative adaptation framework for Neurological Disease Classification that lets new sites adapt a 3D medical vision-language model (VLM) without retraining or sharing patient scans. Each site keeps exact class prototypes for local prediction and can share privacy-protected class summaries: norm-bounded sums and counts perturbed once with calibrated noise. Using 7,641 scans from 67 sites across 12 countries, covering Alzheimer's disease (AD), stroke, epilepsy and controls, we assess local adaptation, cross-site benefits, and effects on existing sites. At seven unseen sites, the frozen VLM's zero-shot AUCs were 0.833-0.945 for AD and stroke. Abstract: A biometric designer controls the number of features and their temporal persistence. Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to adversarial visual perturbations, while defenses often require task-specific adversarial fine-tuning. We investigate whether robustness learned on source manipulation tasks can protect independently specialized target policies without target-side adversarial training. We first show that even a single source defense update improves robustness on held-out tasks, establishing cross-task defense reuse independently of multi-source aggregation. To combine source updates, we introduce Source-Norm Transferable Robustness Vector (SN-TRV), which retains the direction of their mean while calibrating its magnitude using source-update norms. The platform integrates a custom mechanical chassis, a distributed embedded system based on ESP32 microcontrollers, and a Jetson Orin NX module for high-level perception and control. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.18877v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In multi-robot navigation, rigid global schedules are sensitive to execution deviations, while local methods lack long-horizon coordination. We propose a passage-focused framework combining soft global coordination with flexible local execution. A passage-induced graph of convex sets supports priority-ordered planning with two levels of soft coordination. Passage-aware route selection accounts for passage usage and traversal directions, while route-restricted continuous space-time planning penalizes temporal conflicts. The resulting references guide a model predictive path integral controller that avoids collisions online. Adaptive temporal and geometric tracking accommodates execution deviations, while selective replanning maintains coordination without rigid trajectory reservations. Abstract: Robots in homes, warehouses and farms must pick up objects they have never seen, usually without a 3D model or a category label. A grasping policy that works directly on the point cloud from a depth sensor needs only the geometry the robot observes, so it applies to any new object. Offline grasp generators such as Contact-GraspNet work this way, but they rank grasps by learned plausibility rather than by whether the grasp actually lifts the object. Reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize for that directly and make a point-cloud grasping policy much better on average, yet it leaves specific grasps persistently unsolved. We present a human-in-the-loop failure loop that targets those grasps: situations an RL policy keeps failing are mined automatically, sent to a virtual-reality application where a person picks the object up with their own hands, and returned to training as two grasp points. Abstract: Single-point linearization provides a computationally efficient basis for optimization-based trajectory planning of nonlinear robot manipulators. However, planning performance depends on the selected linearization point. This paper presents an offline performance-driven approach that treats the location of a single linearization as an optimization variable. Candidate operating points are sampled from a common cubic seed trajectory, and each corresponding affine model is used to solve an identical constrained finite-horizon quadratic program (QP). The resulting control sequences are executed on the original nonlinear dynamics, and the operating point minimizing the nonlinear trajectory objective is selected through grid search and bounded refinement. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.18982v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper argues that the robotics and AI community should adopt disclosure standards for demonstration videos. As physical and financial constraints limit direct public access to embodied AI, public dissemination of progress in robotics is mainly through curated demonstration videos rather than direct experience with the technology. In a large-scale (N=9,341), pre-registered experiment across six countries, we find that the general public struggles to discern both the visual authenticity (e.g., distinguishing real footage from CGI) and behavioral authenticity (e.g., distinguishing autonomy from teleoperation) of robot demonstration videos. The omission of these details distorts public perception, leading people to overestimate the ability of robots to perform tasks and navigate real world environments. Abstract: A frozen chunked robot policy can spend deployment-time inference compute in two coupled ways: more work within each policy call to refine a predicted action chunk, or more frequent policy calls to replan from fresh observations. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.19047v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Diffusion policies, which generate short action sequences by denoising random noise, are a leading way to learn robot skills from demonstrations. Once deployed, they meet constraints the demonstrations never contained, and retraining for each is impractical. Abstract: Integrating MLLM-based agents with robotic foundation models has attracted increasing attention as a means of enhancing robotic capabilities. Abstract: We study supported reaching to extend a humanoid robot's workspace by bracing against the environment for stabilization using a straightforward yet capable whole-body model predictive control (MPC) approach, exclusively with local sensing and fiducial markers. While typical solutions for whole body humanoid control aim at avoiding or accommodating contact, contact is explicitly required to reach objects placed on surfaces far out of normal reach. We employ sampling-based MPC for whole-body leaning, bracing, reaching, and recovery on a Unitree H1-2 humanoid. The controller runs in real-time at 34 Hz on a laptop, transfers sim-to-real, extends reach by about 50 cm beyond the unbraced standing workspace, and sustains the loaded posture for over four minutes, before pose estimation drifts. Abstract: Autonomous driving is turning to vision-language-action models (VLAs). They answer and plan by decoding, one step at a time. Each step is another forward pass, so a plan can take over a second of GPU time. Embodied AI often pairs such a slow, reasoning System 2 with a fast System 1 that acts. Human drivers plan at a glance, with System 1. Faster designs usually put System 1 outside the vision-language model (VLM), in a planner without its abilities. Yet before a VLM writes its first token, it has already read the scene into one hidden state. We show that, once trained, this hidden state is enough to drive and to answer questions about what the model sees. Abstract: Recovering the forces behind a motion is ill-posed: different controllers can reproduce the same movement while generating different contact forces. articles.content:

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can teach robot teams to navigate shared spaces, but trial and error causes collisions that real robots cannot afford. We propose an approach that builds the filter's safety into the RL policy and examine how such a system behaves during filter-free deployment. However, the filter that keeps training safe also hides what the policy must learn: it masks the cost of unsafe actions, which actor-critic methods then overvalue, and it keeps near-collision states out of the training data. Abstract: Reasoning about what an action will cause requires internalizing how a system behaves. As conditions seldom stay fixed, this must often happen within a few interactions. articles.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
articles.content: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.

articles.title: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.

articles.title: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
articles.content: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregressive video diffusion models that achieves interactive latency without compromising quality. We profile the inference pipeline of state-of-the-art models and find that operations often treated as fixed implementation details, such as VAE decoding and KV cache updates, in fact account for over half of end-to-end inference latency. We challenge the assumption that these components are indispensable and replace them with lightweight alternatives. Our 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame, or 28 responses per second (RPS), on a single B200 GPU while matching the generation quality of a state-of-the-art model that is nearly 8x slower. Our 14B variant runs at 45 ms per frame, or 22 RPS, on an 8x B200 GPU node and yields significantly better visual quality and realism. We show that FastFrames enables real-time interaction in applications such as camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation.

articles.title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
articles.content: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapters and 3,795 pages, covering brane probes, brane webs, geometric engineering, F-theory constructions, wrapped M5-branes and exact worldsheet constructions. Its open-book benchmark inventory contains 1,073 items, including 499 with automatic finite-answer checking. For retrieval-augmented generation, it provides 1,371 section records linked to textbook sources and PDF locations, together with a local lexical retriever. Training-data preparation is illustrated by 21 private, source-linked examples. For agents, it exposes 19 calculation tools with specified inputs and finite domains, connecting tool use to textbook derivations. We illustrate these uses through specific questions, retrieved passages and finite calculations. The textbook collection and accompanying resources are available at https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT.

articles.title: An inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient method for constrained convex finite-sum optimization
articles.content: In this paper, we study a class of constrained convex finite-sum optimization problems. In many practical applications, all or some of the constraints are hard constraints that represent imperative requirements. Consequently, any desirable approximate solution must (nearly) satisfy these constraints. Motivated by this, we focus on computing an $ε$-$surely\ feasible\ stochastic\ optimal$ ($ε$-SFSO) solution, in which the constraint violation is deterministically bounded by $ε$, and the expected optimality gap is at most $ε$. While a recently proposed stochastic variance-reduced first-order penalty method can compute an $ε$-SFSO solution, there remains a significant gap between its first-order oracle complexity for computing an $ε$-SFSO solution and that for computing an $ε$-$expected\ feasible\ stochastic\ optimal$ solution, where both the expected constraint violation and the expected optimality gap are bounded by $ε$. To narrow this gap, we propose an inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient (SVRG) method that significantly improves the previously best-known first-order oracle complexity for computing an $ε$-SFSO solution. Furthermore, when the objective consists of a single function, the proposed method reduces to a novel deterministic first-order method for solving standard convex conic optimization. It achieves a significantly lower gradient evaluation complexity with respect to the objective function compared to existing methods, and can outperform them when computing constraint gradients and projections onto the associated cone is cheaper than evaluating the objective gradient. Preliminary numerical results are presented to illustrate the performance of the proposed method.

articles.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
articles.content: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.

articles.title: What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
articles.content: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias. We audit this on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The head map correlates at $ρ= -0.950$ and $-0.768$ with a label-blind response-length map, apparently identifying a surface confound. An intervention that breaks the length-label coupling rejects this reading: with the prompt held fixed, response length explains 1% of the statistic's variance. What does explain it is prompt identity, at 64% of variance, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at $φ= 0.95$, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map to any of them, and no method in this family performs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated on either model under either reference reading, and no head set we tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal behaviour ($p = 2.7\times10^{-5}$), demonstrating that the pipeline detects effects at this scale.

articles.title: Higher-Scoring Coding Models Did Not Get More Work Done
articles.content: New coding models advertise themselves on score improvements of coding benchmarks. Yet no study has tested if a model that scores higher on these benchmarks gets more real work done. On June 12, 2026, a U.S. export control directive banned access to Claude Fable 5 for 19 days, which forced users to switch to other models. During this time, most former Fable 5 users switched to Opus 4.8 (11 points lower on SWE-Bench Pro compared to Fable 5). We treat this suspension as a natural experiment, where the people and projects stayed the same and only the model changed, so we could isolate the effect of Fable 5 on user productivity. We tracked GitHub pull requests of 297 Fable 5 users before, during, and after the suspension. We used 8,908 developers who stayed on Opus 4.8 all the time as the control group. We also repeated the comparison across five model upgrades before and after the suspension in 2026 (1,208 developers, 15,442 pull requests). Fitting a difference-in-differences model with developer and date fixed effects, we found that having access to Fable 5 increased the 7-day merge rate of pull requests by only 1.4 percentage points [-1.4; +4.3], which was not statistically significant. Similarly, no significant increases of merge rates were found with the upgrades (weighted mean: -0.9 percentage points [-1.9; +0.2]); all five estimates were negative (95% intervals included 0, did not differ from each other). We also did not observe a significant increase in the number of pull requests merged per week (+2.4% [-4.9%; +10.2%]).

articles.title: Feedback-Linearised Trajectory Tracking via Model-Informed Robust Geometric DDPC
articles.content: Data-driven predictive control (DDPC) predicts system responses from recorded trajectories, but nonlinear dynamics can limit the accuracy of fixed linear predictors. This paper studies geometric robust DDPC for trajectory tracking of a fully actuated manipulator using model-based feedback linearisation. A mechanical model maps virtual acceleration commands into joint torques, while recorded data capture residual dynamics arising from imperfect model parameters. The controller minimises worst-case prediction error over an open Grassmannian ball centred at the fitted trajectory subspace. Simulations on a planar 2R manipulator under gravity compare the proposed method with double-integrator model predictive control (MPC) and direct regularised data-enabled predictive control (DeePC). Results show improved tracking over double-integrator MPC despite increased torque effort, while performance relative to DeePC depends on the reference trajectory.

articles.title: EviSlide-MIL: Multi-Query Pooling and Shared Prediction for Class-Incremental Whole-Slide Image Classification
articles.content: Histopathological analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) plays a critical role in cancer diagnosis, and multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely adopted for WSI analysis under weak supervision. As new tumor subtypes are introduced, extending existing MIL models requires learning new classes while retaining knowledge of previously learned ones. This presents a class-incremental learning challenge, where models must acquire new classes with limited access to historical training data and recognize all learned classes without task identifiers at inference. A major obstacle is forgetting, as updates to feature aggregation and prediction modules can degrade performance on previously learned classes. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{EviSlide-MIL}, a class-incremental WSI framework that integrates multiple learnable queries per class with a shared prediction module. The queries aggregate frozen patch features into class-specific representations, while the shared prediction module limits parameter growth across incremental stages. By freezing queries associated with previously learned classes, EviSlide-MIL preserves their attention patterns for identical inputs, while experience replay and knowledge distillation further mitigate forgetting as shared parameters are updated. Experiments on eight tumor subtypes from The Cancer Genome Atlas demonstrate that EviSlide-MIL achieves improved performance and reduced forgetting compared with competing methods across most learning settings, demonstrating its potential for scalable and knowledge-preserving WSI classification. Code and pretrained models will be released.

articles.title: Multimodal Masked Diffusion Autoencoder for Modeling Impaired Driving
articles.content: Human cognitive state (e.g., distraction, stress), gaze, and behavior interact with the driving environment in subtle ways that AI could use to assist drivers, but ground-truth labels for human cognitive state levels are costly to obtain at scale. We propose a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder, ID-MAE, that adds a self-supervised objective to impairment prediction: alongside predicting the impairment label as a masked token, it reconstructs masked gaze and trajectory. To probe the effects of different modalities and types of impairments on model inference, we introduce DIVERT, a driving-simulator dataset containing 103 hours of driving data (n = 109) with ten impairment inductions spanning cognitive, visual, and emotional states, recorded with gaze, vehicle state, and scene video. We demonstrate how ID-MAE affords significant improvements in impairment inference results on both the DIVERT dataset and existing datasets, and enables strong results in additional tasks, such as trajectory and gaze prediction. For location-matched pairs, our model achieves a paired AUC of 0.706 for impairment detection on DIVERT, compared to 0.590 without reconstruction loss, improving over existing baselines. We probe the design space in terms of input modalities, masking scheme, positional encoding, attention mechanism, and decoding. We also investigate the interaction between various impairments in training and inference, demonstrating that visually demanding distractions are separable from cognitive distractions. Code and data will be available upon acceptance.

articles.title: Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
articles.content: Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Human gaze provides a window into this process, making gaze a useful source of guidance for visually-grounded reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs). However, human gaze also includes noise and redundancies that may transfer poorly to VLMs. In this work, we investigate how human gaze data can be effectively leveraged to improve visual reasoning in VLMs, while maintaining alignment with human behavior. We collect 7,109 human gaze trials from a diverse and challenging set of visual reasoning tasks, and train grounded reasoning models with different forms of gaze guidance. Across evaluations in chart understanding, visual search, and counting, we find that using human gaze as a prior for grounded reasoning consistently outperforms supervision using the full gaze sequence. Based on these findings, we introduce GGR (Gaze-Guided Reasoner), which achieves greater human alignment and more reliable visual grounding while matching or outperforming leading grounded-reasoning baselines in accuracy. Reinforcement learning further improves task accuracy, gaze alignment, and grounding quality despite using no gaze supervision. Behavioral analyses show that gaze supervised models exhibit more visual exploration before arriving at an answer. Our results suggest that the value of human gaze lies in guiding spatial exploration and shaping reasoning behavior without requiring complete imitation of human behavior.

articles.title: Distortion-Free Semantic Watermarks for Black-Box Generative Models
articles.content: We present a provably distortion-free semantic watermarking algorithm that requires only black-box sampling access to a generative model and black-box access to a semantic embedding. A watermark is called distortion-free if, averaged over its secret detection key, it leaves the generator's output distribution unchanged; this provides a formal guarantee that watermarking does not reduce output quality. Conventional such watermarks are often brittle to transformations. This is especially problematic for images, where benign operations such as compression, cropping, or resizing change the entire pixel representation. Semantic watermarks therefore require detection to be robust to content-preserving transformations. Previous methods combining these properties rely heavily on specific white-box properties of the underlying model: either to autoregressive text generation or to diffusion-specific access, such as control of the initial noise or diffusion inversion. In contrast, our construction is fully generic: It only interacts with the generative model and the semantic embedding, a function that determines the notion of "preserving content" under which detection should be robust, via sample and query access. We then instantiate this framework for image generation. We characterize the two competing properties required of the semantic embedding: it should remain stable under transformations that preserve an image's content, but should distinguish independent generations from the same prompt. We train an image encoder directly for this tradeoff. The resulting encoder improves separation while maintaining stability over off-the-shelf alternatives and enables strong aggregate detection while remaining robust to various transformations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our watermark scheme on both open-source and closed models, which is possible only due to restriction to black-box access.

articles.title: Reading Scene States: Uncovering Safety Failures in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) can provide harmful assistance by interpreting visual events, even without an explicit request for the underlying harmful objective. We identify this \textbf{scene-state safety vulnerability} and introduce \textbf{SceneSafetyBench}, comprising 375 image--question pairs spanning Initial, Medium, and Ultimate scene states and five visual presentations. Across eight VLMs, scene-state inputs elicit harmful assistance with attack success rates (ASRs) of 45.6--72.3\%. Comparative analysis across three VLMs shows that scene-state inputs most closely resemble QR-related images in their layer-wise safety-related signal profiles, while exhibiting lower average late-layer readouts and distinct signal dynamics during generation. To turn this vulnerability into a systematic attack, we propose \textbf{S3TA}, which translates harmful objectives into scene states, queries image--question pairs independently, and assembles the responses. On seven MM-SafetyBench categories across eight open-weight and commercial VLMs, S3TA achieves a model-average ASR of \textbf{71.2\%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.1 percentage points}. Text-side filters and visual moderation provide limited protection. These findings highlight the need to safeguard the assistance models infer through scene-grounded reasoning, beyond screening input content.

articles.title: Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
articles.content: Small language models that run on a laptop are attractive for writing signal-processing code offline, but they make systematic errors on digital signal processing (DSP) conventions. We apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to the Gemma 4 edge models E2B and E4B with 66 checked examples covering 11 signal-processing MATLAB subtasks, using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and quantized LoRA (QLoRA) on the integrated GPU (iGPU) of a laptop, and deploy the 8-bit integer (int8) models with the adapters through OpenVINO. On held-out variants scored by deterministic checkers, the pass rate rises from 18/66 to 37/66 (LoRA) and 37/66 (QLoRA) for E2B and from 32/66 to 47/66 for E4B (QLoRA). Reading all 159 failing programs shows that the adapters remove most errors of convention, such as the sign of a lag, units and array shapes, but few errors in building signals and noise. Applied at run time, the adapter costs 17-19% of the generation speed.

articles.title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
articles.content: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.

articles.title: Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency
articles.content: Trajectory prediction models for automated driving are usually trained on data with a fixed sampling frequency, while positions received via vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication arrive at 1-10 Hz. We study whether a learned predictor that uses only the observation history keeps its advantage over constant velocity (CV) and constant acceleration (CA) models when the history frequency drops. On the Argoverse 2 motion forecasting dataset, the 5 s history of the focal agent was downsampled from 10 Hz to 5, 2, and 1 Hz, and the 6 s future was predicted without maps or neighboring agents. An LSTM-based recurrent neural network (RNN) trained for each frequency was compared with the same network trained at 10 Hz and applied to sparse histories after linear interpolation. Hypotheses and thresholds were fixed before training, the main RNNs were trained with ten seeds each, and results on 24,984 test scenarios have bootstrap confidence intervals over scenarios and seeds. The average displacement error of the frequency-specific RNN grew by 3.1% at 5 Hz, 10.1% at 2 Hz, and 20.3% at 1 Hz. Contrary to our hypothesis, its advantage over the better kinematic model did not vanish on straight motion and was 24-30% on both straight motion and turns at every frequency, while for pedestrians CV was more accurate. The 10 Hz model with interpolation was at most 1.3% less accurate than the frequency-specific model down to 2 Hz but 11.5% less accurate at 1 Hz. Each hypothesis was only partly supported.

articles.title: Structure--Residual Inductive Biases for Language Model Pretraining
articles.content: Next-token prediction is relied upon to learn both predictive behavior and internal representations. We ask whether representation structure itself should be an explicit inductive bias. Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we study a structure--residual principle in which a representation separates structure from realization detail. We instantiate this principle in two complementary ways. Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) routes information from token segments through boundary carriers while preserving local autoregressive computation. Continuous Concept (CC) regularizes representation geometry and induces a spectral decomposition into low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual. We derive coding bounds for both views and show that multiplicity-corrected boundary attention becomes exact as the within-segment path energy vanishes. Empirically, BBC and CC exhibit strikingly different depth preferences: BBC works best in early layers, whereas CC is most effective in later layers. At 300M training tokens, combining BBC and CC improves NLL by 1.44\% on GPT-2 Medium. These gains persist with training runs up to 20B tokens. Representation diagnostics show that BBC increases the relative predictive importance of boundary states, while CC reduces spectral residual energy. Together, these results suggest that structure--residual biases can improve language-model pretraining beyond next-token prediction. Code: https://github.com/haihuang-ml/structure-residual

articles.title: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
articles.content: Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed.   We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior over goals. We evaluate WoRD on simulated robot settings, pedestrian trajectories, and vehicle trajectories using four metrics targeting distinct failure modes. Across all three settings, the same inference procedure preserves calibrated multimodal beliefs through ambiguous prefixes where filter- and classifier-based observers collapse to a single mode or grow overconfident.

articles.title: Retrieval-Augmented Correction for Generalist Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Automated segmentation is routinely used as the first step in quantitative image-based clinical workflows, where predicted masks are subsequently reviewed and corrected by human operators. Automated correction of the residual structural errors is currently addressed one anatomy at a time, so the number of trained correctors scales with the number of segmentation targets. We present GRACE, a retrieval-augmented refiner that edits an input mask under context drawn from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases. The refiner is trained once on a multi-organ corpus spanning compact organs, cavities, branching vessels, and tumour lesions. In the held-out dataset-transfer evaluation, three held-out datasets query a fixed knowledge base built from training data only. A separate leave-one-anatomy-out experiment tests parameter-free index extension: verified cases of an unseen solid organ enter the knowledge base, and the refiner stays frozen. A light shape-aware projection head on a frozen multimodal encoder maps embedding similarity to the shape agreement of the masks, so the knowledge base returns cases that the refiner can use as a shape prior. We evaluate GRACE on 18 public datasets spanning CT, MRI and ultrasound, using nine refinement configurations and seven upstream segmentors that span weak, mid, and strong operating regimes. We report each change with the DSC of its input mask. On the weak tier, the input DSC is 0.386 and GRACE adds up to +0.35 DSC. On a strong segmentor, the input DSC is 0.932 and the mean change is small. Transfer to an imaging modality that is absent from training and from the index is partial and depends on the anatomy, and remains an open research direction. Our results suggest retrieval-conditioned refinement is a practical alternative to anatomy-specific correction models. Code: https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace

articles.title: Any2Building: Unifying Point Clouds and Images for Building Reconstruction via Shared Spatial Queries
articles.content: Abstracting structured buildings from limited observations is essential for 3D urban modeling and digital twins. Partial point clouds and overhead images of the same building provide incomplete 3D surface measurements and visual cues to its footprint, roof geometry, and rooftop structures, respectively. This motivates a unified framework that aligns geometric and visual cues in 3D and reconstructs buildings from either or both modalities. Building on this connection, we present Any2Building, a unified model for Level of Detail 2 (LoD2) building reconstruction from partial point clouds, overhead images, or both, with optional coarse geometric priors. At its core is an occupancy-grounded shared spatial queries representation that organizes available observations within a common 3D grid. Supervised by complete building surface voxels, these queries connect observational evidence to target geometry, enabling a shared generator to learn structural priors across tasks and providing spatial guidance for recovering missing structure. A trained voxel conditional surface-generation and low-poly remeshing pipeline then converts the predicted structure into compact LoD2 building models. To support this framework, we introduce BuildingWorld-Image, comprising approximately one million paired samples of partial point clouds, overhead images, and LoD2 building models across 18 cities. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Any2Building outperforms existing methods in geometric reconstruction accuracy across unimodal and multimodal point-cloud completion, single-image building generation, and prior-assisted generation, while maintaining detailed and robust recovery when point cloud input modality is degraded.

articles.title: Polarity Composition Hypothesis: Causal Evidence from Negation in NLI
articles.content: We investigate how language models process negation in natural language inference (NLI). We propose the \textit{Polarity Composition Hypothesis}, a high-level causal model of this computation. Behavioral evaluations show that language-model predictions largely conform to the proposed hypothesis. Using Distributed Alignment Search, we identify causally effective subspaces aligned with the variables in the polarity-composition hypothesis. These representations transfer across negation forms and partially to a subset of MNLI. We release the dataset and code.

articles.title: Say Less, Hallucinate Less? Diagnosing and Restoring Object Coverage in Preference-Optimized Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Preference optimization (PO) is the standard way to reduce object hallucination in large vision-language models. We find that four public PO checkpoints of LLaVA-1.5-7B also lower object coverage. They name fewer object categories, and their lower hallucination rates bring no significant gain in set-level object F1 on CHAIR. We therefore ask how much of the PO gain the base model can reproduce by stopping earlier. A positive end-of-sequence (EOS) logit bias lets the base model reach the recall of each PO model, and this early stopping alone reproduces 58 to 86 percent of the CHAIRi gain of three checkpoints on two disjoint COCO sets. Writing longer does not bring the lost categories back. Under greedy decoding, a negative EOS bias recovers only 2 to 9 percent of the lost CHAIR recall of these checkpoints, and 94 to 96 percent of the added object mentions repeat categories already named. On CHAIR, the base caption of the same image still names about half of the missed object categories. We therefore propose base-guided object-category restoration, which appends high-confidence base-only categories to the PO caption without training. With thresholds fixed on a development set, it brings three checkpoints within one point of the base recall on a held-out COCO set with a lower distinct-object hallucination rate than the base model. Against the recall-matched base stopping curve, its gain holds for RLAIF-V near the base recall and for RLAIF-V and CHAIR-DPO at an intermediate recall. We will release the code of the recall-controlled evaluation.
